items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I was living with George Horton

ctx.x: He used to play poker with Hank, come in up there then. Hank would tell me about the poker game.

Well Hank, I remember Hank in New York, I was living with George Horton and the Common Massarin Brothers used to come around. Al? Al, yeah. We had a little apartment there, I think it was on 49th Street. I remember when Hank first came to New York, he'd put up there, he had the North and Mississippi Republic of the apartment. He was down there almost twenty years now, didn't he? Something like that. I told you about one day my daughter came home, my daughter went to Junior High at Burgos, and she came home and…
Well listen, when you first went to New York, what band was that you played with? You said at this dancing place?
